source: TNPDCL domestic tariff effective 2025-07-01, monthly-equivalent form. PLACEHOLDER: no primary TNERC/TNPDCL order has been read for these slabs yet - see verification_status.
notes: Slab bounds are (slab_from, slab_to]: slab_from is EXCLUSIVE, slab_to is INCLUSIVE.
So {slab_from: 100, slab_to: 200} covers units 101..200, matching the published '101-200' slab label.
Rates are JSON strings, never numbers, so they parse straight into Decimal with no binary float in the path.

PRD 10 (must verify) OPEN: TN bills BIMONTHLY. The free allowance is 100 units, reportedly rising to 200 for consumers at or below 500 units bimonthly. That is NOT a simple 2x scaling of this monthly-equivalent schedule. Do not ship a bimonthly conversion until the primary TNERC order is read - see tariff.schedule.to_billing_period().
Acceptance criterion PRD 10 (acceptance criteria): computed bill must match 5 real TNPDCL bills TO THE RUPEE. Until tests/fixtures/bills/real_bills.json is populated, this schedule is unvalidated.
